entries.name: On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Magic)

system.description: Bolster your defenses with magic, gaining up to 10 Shield points. This spell will not increase your Shield past 10 points. (Shield points are temporary HP that absorb damage dealt to the unit. If all damage from an attack or effect is absorbed, any Stance damage that would normally accompany the attack or effect is negated.)
Protected from Arcane damage. Vulnerable to Slashing damage.
Launch a cordon of arcane bolts that home in and follow your target, ensuring a nigh guaranteed hit.
